llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Baidu Maps integration that sends map and routing requests to Baidu and uses a user-provided token, with one usability caution around optional browser opening.

dimensions.detail: Network calls to https://api.map.baidu.com/ and https://lbs.baidu.com are expected for a Baidu Maps skill, and the local environment access is limited to reading the configured token.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill file with frontmatter declaring curl and BAIDU_MAP_AUTH_TOKEN requirements; no bundled executable scripts, dependencies, or install-time mutation behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly focused on Baidu Maps API usage and include safeguards against invented coordinates, but the documentation is entirely in Chinese and MapRender defaults to opening a browser after explicit map-visualization intent.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background agents, scheduled tasks, privilege escalation, memory writes, or local file modification instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to provide Baidu Maps place search, routing, geocoding, reverse geocoding, weather, and map display; the documented curl calls and required BAIDU_MAP_AUTH_TOKEN align with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you are comfortable sending map queries, addresses, coordinates, and your Baidu Maps authorization token to Baidu's map APIs. Be aware that map visualization may open a browser window by default when you ask to see results on a map.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The skill text is Chinese-only, which is a localization and usability limitation, but it is coherent with a Baidu Maps integration and is not evidence of hidden or unsafe behavior.
[AS3] unexpected: The cited text appears to be a literal package/path reference in the description, not an instruction to enumerate or read other installed skills.
[E1] expected: The repeated external URL findings reflect documented Baidu Maps API calls needed for search, routing, geocoding, weather, and rendering; the artifact does not instruct sending unrelated local files or secrets beyond the required authorization token.
[SQP-2] expected: MapRender documents opening the generated Baidu map URL with open, xdg-open, or start only when the user explicitly asks to view results on a map; this should be understood as a visible side effect, but it is disclosed and purpose-aligned.
